elements_not_encoded.text: If bleeding, apply direct pressure and elevate limb.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Management, medicine or referral step (no manage tasks in this pass).

elements_not_encoded.text: If shock2 /systolic BP < 80, give sodium chloride 0.9% 1L IV rapidly, repeat until systolic BP > 80. Continue 1L 6 hourly. Stop if breathing worsens.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Management, medicine or referral step (no manage tasks in this pass).

elements_not_encoded.text: Remove loose/dead skin. Wash wound with soap under running water for 15 minutes, clean with chlorhexidine 0.05% or povidone iodine 10% solution. Apply dressing.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Management, medicine or referral step (no manage tasks in this pass).

elements_not_encoded.reason: Management, medicine or referral step (no manage tasks in this pass).

judgment_calls.alternatives: Bite of order Scorpiones (event, not a clinical finding); Venomous sting (too broad)

judgment_calls.topic: Spider bite with drooling, restlessness, muscle cramps
judgment_calls.decision: Spider bite AND any one of the three signs
judgment_calls.alternatives: Spider bite with all three; spider bite alone

judgment_calls.topic: Anaphylaxis item 'or exposure to possible allergen'
judgment_calls.decision: Read as the context (the bite/sting itself, per footnote 3); probable anaphylaxis = bite/sting AND any sudden-onset symptom
judgment_calls.alternatives: Treat exposure as a standalone criterion (would make every bite/sting anaphylaxis likely)

judgment_calls.alternatives: Restrict to spider/insect bites and low-risk animal bites (routing not expressible)
